Given that $\operatorname{tan}⁡(m∠A)=2,$ the **exact** area of $△ABC$ shown above is{{field-1}} square units.
feedback.worked_solution:
In this case, the area of the right triangle is

$$
A=\frac{1}{2}BC\cdot AC.
$$

We are given that $\operatorname{tan}⁡(m∠A)=2.$ Notice that relative to $∠A,$ we have expressions for the lengths of the opposite side $\overset{―}{BC}$ and adjacent side $\overset{―}{AC}.$ Hence, we can use the tangent ratio to solve for $x:$

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{tan}⁡(m∠A) & =\frac{BC}{AC} \\ 2 & =\frac{9x+2}{5x-1} \\ 2(5x-1) & =9x+2 \\ 10x-2 & =9x+2 \\ x & =4\end{aligned}
$$

So, the side lengths are

$$
\begin{aligned}BC & =9x+2=9(4)+2=38, \\ AC & =5x-1=5(4)-1=19.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the area of $△ABC$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =\frac{1}{2}BC\cdot AC \\  & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot 38\cdot 19 \\  & =361.\end{aligned}
$$
